svg.title: Epithalamin, Thymalin, Epitalon: the paper trail
svg.desc: 1973: Pineal extract studied for hypothalamic sensitivity and tumors in rats; 1977: 'Epithalamine' in one patient with low immune indices (case report); 1979: Pineal extract: rat lifespan +10% and +25% (20-month treatment); 1982: Thymalin approved in the USSR (Order No. 1008) as an immunomodulator; 1985: US 5,070,076 priority: Morozov and Khavinson thymus preparation; 1992: Kiev cohort starts (152 outpatients); St Petersburg follows in 1996; 1999: RU 2157233: synthetic Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly (Epitalon); 14 + 11 patients; 2002: Mortality paper: 266 people, 'prolong human life' (2003 English); 2003: Telomerase/telomere claim: one fetal fibroblast culture study

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
